//: Every number below is a placeholder. Copy to data/config.json and fill it in with the real ones. data/ is gitignored, which is where the real numbers live: this repository is public and an address, a budget and a child's school run are not facts to publish.
label: example, not real numbers

geography.//: The office every drive is measured from. Fill origin_lat and origin_lon in, or nothing can be scored: a drive time from nowhere is not a number.
geography.//ideal: The search envelope is a drive-time band, not a lat/lon box, because the roads here do not run straight. Ideal scores full marks, max is the edge of the normal search, and anything between max and stretch lands in the stretch section instead of the grid.
geography.//north: The stated north bound. A listing above this latitude is out whatever its drive time says.
geography.//arc: Degrees clockwise from true north, as seen from the office. 150 to 310 is south through west, which is what settles the east bound: anything east of 150 is out.

filters.//water: One buffer per kind of water, because they are not the same risk. NHD maps every wet-weather ditch in these counties and nearly every rural parcel has one inside 300 ft, so buffering all three alike excludes most of the county without finding any flood risk. Zero means that kind never excludes and only moves the score.
filters.//aadt_radius: A traffic count only speaks for the frontage if the counted segment is next to the house. NCDOT counts the highway and not the lane beside it.
filters.//manufactured: An old house with good bones is fine, an old manufactured one is not. Modular is in the list so it is recognised and is deliberately not excluded, since it is built to the residential code on a permanent foundation.
filters.//corner: How close a second road has to be to count as road on another side of the house. Off a small road that leads to a main road is the good case and is not this.
filters.//highway: Nobody wants an interstate at the bottom of the garden and everybody wants to be able to reach one. Under the first number is close enough to hear it, past the second it stops mattering. Measured to the pavement, not to the slip road.
filters.//severity: Per rule, exclude or penalty. The five he called hard filters exclude. The rest are wants: points off and a chip on the card, since none of them sinks an otherwise perfect house on its own. Flip any of them here.
filters.//penalties: What a penalty costs, out of a hundred.

money.//tax: Combined county plus municipal rate per $100 of assessed value. A county:city key wins over the bare county one, since a house inside town limits pays both. Put the current year's rates here, they move every revaluation.
money.//revalued: The year each county's last general reappraisal took effect. An assessed value is as of this year, and the estimate carries it forward on the FHFA index from here, so a wrong year is a whole cycle of drift. The report prints the year it used.

//destinations: Everywhere other than work a drive is measured to. Geocode each one and paste the coordinate, since a wrong coordinate here is a wrong number on every card.
//weights: The eight scored factors, out of whatever they add up to. Editing one changes the ranking and not the scale, because a score is divided by the total.
